item.title: MOMO
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: MOMO unifies physical, verbal and graphical robot skill adaptation on a 7-DoF torque-controlled robot. Published in IEEE RA-P 2026.

item.title: CLASP
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: CLASP combines Vision-Language Models with Task-Parameterized KMPs for language-driven robot skill selection, composition and active acquisition from 2–5 demos.

item.title: IROSA
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: IROSA adapts robot skills through natural language with a tool-based LLM architecture over Kernelized Movement Primitives. Published in IEEE RA-L 2026.

item.title: LOCI
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: LOCI: interactive incremental learning of generalizable robot skills with local trajectory modulation (TP-KMP). Published in IEEE RA-L 2025.

item.title: RACCOON
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: RACCOON grounds embodied question-answering in a robot’s own world and task models using RAG, raising truthful answers from 15.9% to 82.5%. IEEE ICRA 2025.

item.title: RECALL
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: RECALL: A rehearsal-free continual learning approach for object classification achieving state-of-the-art results. Published at IEEE IROS 2022.

item.title: HOWS-CL-25
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: HOWS-CL-25: A synthetic dataset with 150,795 unique images across 25 household object categories for continual learning research, created using BlenderProc.

item.title: BlenderProc
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: BlenderProc: open source procedural pipeline for photorealistic synthetic training images — RGB, depth, segmentation, normals and poses. 3.4k+ GitHub stars.

item.title: Two Next-Gen Spotlight Awards at ICRA 2026 in Vienna
item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: Two Next-Gen Spotlight Awards at IEEE ICRA 2026 in Vienna for CLASP and IROSA — natural language-driven robot skill selection and adaptation.

item.author: m.knauer@tum.de (Markus Knauer)
item.description: ELLIS Cambridge (Probabilistic ML) and OxML Oxford (Representation Learning & Generative AI) summer schools 2025: highlights and key insights.
